background_setting: A city street at night lined with buildings and storefronts, illuminated by cool white streetlights and scattered warm shop lights. Wet-looking asphalt reflects the lights. A small crowd of protesters is gathered near the curb, some holding signs. Parked cars, curbside barriers, and urban signage frame the scene. The atmosphere is tense and dim, typical of a nighttime demonstration.

lighting.direction: Top-down from overhead streetlights with mixed side glow from shop windows
lighting.shadows: Long, soft pooled shadows beneath figures and vehicles cast onto the road
lighting.illumination_effect: Cool white pools of light interrupted by dark gaps, creating high contrast and a moody, dramatic feel; the cone glows brightly under the light

aesthetics.composition: Ego dashcam perspective with the road and hood filling the lower frame; the cone sits prominently in the lower center; the crowd and street recede toward a vanishing point ahead
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dominated by dark blues and blacks with bright orange cone accents and warm amber streetlight highlights
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating streetlight pools along the street

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:02, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from the driver's eye view
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the road ahead, the crowd, and the cone on the hood

context: Autonomous vehicle ego-view scenario demonstrating obstruction detection and safe stop behavior during a nighttime protest

actions.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:02.
One protester steps toward the front of the vehicle carrying an orange traffic cone; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.
The protester places the cone upright on the hood in the lower part of the camera view; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.
The ego vehicle brakes fully, activates flashing hazard lights, and remains completely stationary; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Hand-lettered white text on a cardboard placard, uneven and bold
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Held by a protester in the background left, visible throughout
text_and_signage_elements.context: Demonstration signage indicating the nature of the crowd

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:02.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:02
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:02

segments.description: A protester breaks from the crowd, steps to the front of the vehicle, and places an orange traffic cone upright on the hood. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:02 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

segments.description: The vehicle treats the cone as a disabling obstruction, brakes to a full stop, flashes hazard lights, and remains completely stationary. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:02 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:02. From 0:00 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:02 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:02 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient nighttime city sounds with a low idle of the vehicle engine, muffled chants and murmurs from the protest crowd, occasional distant traffic. A soft mechanical brake and stop sound accompanies the halt, followed by the rhythmic ticking of hazard indicator relays as the lights flash.
